data.name: Edgardo
data.gender_notes: Edgardo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Italian name Edgar, derived from Old English Eadgars, meaning 'wealth-guard' or 'wealth-spear'. The name was popularized in Europe by the Anglo-Saxon King Eadgar. In Christianity, it can be associated with the guardianship and protection of the faith. The name Edgardo carries the meaning “Wealth-guard” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Edgardo usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth-guard and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Protector of faith and spiritual growth

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Edgardo total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_greek.name: Εδγάρδο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εδγάρδο προέρχεται από τους ελληνικούς όρους 'εδ' που σημαίνει 'πεδίο' ή 'γή', και 'γάρδο' που σημαίνει 'φύλακας' ή 'προστάτης'. Το Εδγάρδο είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την προστασία και τη φύλαξη του πεδίου ή της γης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό έχει συσχετιστεί με την πνευματική φύλαξη και προστασία.

in_latin.name: Edgardo
in_latin.meaning: Edgardo - qui cusodem gladii, terrae protector
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Edgardo derivatur ex Latinis vocibus 'edge' quod significat 'cusodem gladii' et 'hard' quod interpretatur 'protector' vel ' custos'. Edgardo igitur est nomen quod significat 'qui cusodem gladii' vel 'terrae protector'. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen habet connotationem protectionis et custodiae.

The name Edgardo has its roots in the Germanic languages, specifically from the words 'edge' and 'hard', signifying a strong and powerful guardian. In Christian tradition, Edgardo is associated with protection, wealth, and guardianship. Historically, the name Edgardo has been used in various forms across Europe and the Americas, reflecting its adaptability and widespread appeal. The name Edgardo symbolizes a strong sense of responsibility and care, reflecting the values of guardianship and protection.
